'''Antarian''',<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> sometimes called '''Gotal''',<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> was the official [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]], specially of the native [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Antar/Legends|Antar]], on [[Antar 4/Legends|Prindaar]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons" />

Gotals outside Prindaar also used Antarian as their main language. However, most Gotals learned to speak both Antarian and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] since they were a part of the [[Galactic community]]. The language had a written form.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
